name: Hello
tagline: Minimal sanity-check plugin used to verify the marketplace auto-sync pipeline.
description: A tiny one-command plugin (`/hello`) that exists so we can prove a new plugin merged into the Nocetic/plugins monorepo flows through CI, lands in registry.json, and surfaces on the public marketplace. No tools, no integrations, no env requirements — just an echo. Safe to leave installed or remove at any time.
